test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If

'P + Q' means 'P is the father of Q',

'P − Q' means 'P is the mother of Q',

'P / Q' means 'P is the sister of Q',

'P U Q' means 'P is the son of Q',

'P ∩ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q',

then which of the following means that ' A is E's daughter's son?

options.text: A / B + C − D U E

solution:
**Given:** 

'P + Q' means 'P is the father of Q',

'P − Q' means 'P is the mother of Q',

'P / Q' means 'P is the sister of Q',

'P U Q' means 'P is the son of Q',

'P ∩ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ee8d234dd9174c974deb4cc70aa9dbcf9e13cb54fde9438ca229bee24830637.png] ​​

**Explanation:**

 
• **Option 1: A ∩ B ∩ C / D + E**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/289fa0e0659f75d3e2e756aecc75a46a64bc5cac8ad38079f75574262862f1c0.png] 
 
• Here, A is a female. So, this option is incorrect.
 
• **Option 2: A / B ∪ C ∪ D / E**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fd99354d1a8bae6ad927f4beee158e03b5ee3a0a3b7e86bd2d37f06ea1cfe62.png] 
 
• Here, A is a female. So, this option is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3:A / B + C − D U E**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55d35af9c8ff407e0d8e7cbc07a968f9c95e1eca8c880d06ef83d0ebdddc30b1.png] 
 
• Here, A is a female. So, this option is incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: A ∪ B / C / D ∪ E**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41f75769ab4f0e6cac1f44ec3d56f15206bed6f42443c6aed55c6e94c4e62e87.png] 
 
• Here, A is the son of E's daughter, B.
 
• Hence, **A ∪ B / C / D ∪ E **is the **correct answer.**
